      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "from sklearn.ensemble import IsolationForest\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import classification_report, confusion_matrix\n",
        "from sklearn.neighbors import LocalOutlierFactor\n",
        "from sklearn.preprocessing import RobustScaler\n",
        "\n",
        "url = \"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nsethi31/Kaggle-Data-Credit-Card-Fraud-Detection/master/creditcard.csv\"\n",
        "df = pd.read_csv(url)\n",
        "\n",
        "scaler = RobustScaler()\n",
        "df['scaled_amount'] = scaler.fit_transform(df[['Amount']])\n",
        "df['scaled_time'] = scaler.fit_transform(df[['Time']])\n",
        "df = df.drop(columns=['Time', 'Amount'])\n",
        "\n",
        "df_sample = df.sample(n=20000, random_state=42)\n",
        "X_sample = df_sample.drop(columns=['Class'])\n",
        "y_sample = df_sample['Class']\n",
        "\n",
        "rate = float((y_sample == 1).sum() / len(y_sample))\n",
        "print(\"Sample fraud rate:\", rate)\n",
        "\n",
        "iso = IsolationForest(n_estimators=100, contamination=rate, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1)\n",
        "y_pred_iso = np.where(iso.fit_predict(X_sample) == -1, 1, 0)\n",
        "\n",
        "lof = LocalOutlierFactor(n_neighbors=20, contamination=rate, n_jobs=-1)\n",
        "y_pred_lof = np.where(lof.fit_predict(X_sample) == -1, 1, 0)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"--- Isolation Forest ---\")\n",
        "print(classification_report(y_sample, y_pred_iso, digits=4))\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"--- Local Outlier Factor ---\")\n",
        "print(classification_report(y_sample, y_pred_lof, digits=4))\n",
        "\n",
        "fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(8, 3))\n",
        "sns.heatmap(confusion_matrix(y_sample, y_pred_iso), annot=True, fmt='d', cmap='Blues', ax=ax[0])\n",
        "ax[0].set_title(\"Isolation Forest\")\n",
        "sns.heatmap(confusion_matrix(y_sample, y_pred_lof), annot=True, fmt='d', cmap='Oranges', ax=ax[1])\n",
        "ax[1].set_title(\"Local Outlier Factor\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Day 2 completed successfully!\")\n"
      ],
